Here, we need to make this more obvious. By default, there will be no ride preselected, but there should still be nice hover and click states. When one of the options is clicked, it should make the Choose Comfort button clickable.

Before, it will just say "Choose your ride in the city" at the bottom, but it won't be clickable. Maybe we could even have a tooltip that says, "We need to select a ride type first," above. That way, it would be more interactive and easier for the user to understand where to click. It's going to be first on the ride option and then on the CTA.  @marver
On it - selection states, gated CTA, and a nudge tooltip.

No ride preselected now - rows have real hover/press states, and the CTA only wakes up once you pick one.

Tooltip nudges you if you press it early.
